        <script>

        // keeping any query string and #anchor.
        (function () {
          var p = location.pathname;

          if (m && p.indexOf("/chapters/") === -1) {
            location.replace(m[1] + "chapters/" + m[2] + location.search + location.hash);
          }
        })();
        </script>
